title: Capstone 04 Modernization Bridge

levels.1: FDW is named but not wired to useful legacy tables.
levels.2: Foreign tables exist but local ownership, cache freshness, or failure handling is weak.
levels.3: FDW, IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA, local writes, materialized views, and RLS boundaries are coherent.
levels.4: The design includes pushdown awareness, stale-cache controls, migration sequencing, and clear ownership boundaries.

levels.2: The explanation misses a core legacy, RLS, FDW, or migration tradeoff.
levels.3: The writeup defends FDW now, logical replication later, Citus not now, cache policy, and local correctness.
levels.4: The writeup gives measurable promotion criteria and shows how the bridge can be unwound during migration.

notes: Weights emphasize accurate bridge reads, local correctness, RLS, failure-mode thinking, and extension discipline.
